notes: Printed: '[-2]: Whenever one or more NONTOKEN creatures attack this turn, create THAT MANY 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.' Two nontoken Bears and one creature token attack together: that many = 2 (the token is not a nontoken creature), so 2 Soldiers, and seat 1 takes 2+2+1+1+1 = 7 (life 13). W4-1 (review wave 4, fixed 2026-10-30): the declaration register 'that many' reads holds only the attackers the trigger's own event spec matches; before, it held every attacker, so the token counted (3 Soldiers, life 12).
